macros.name: la
macros.doc: The command \la changes the current font family to la and the encoding to T1.

macros.name: lla
macros.doc: The command \lla changes the current font family to lla and the encoding to T1.

macros.name: llafill
macros.doc: The command \llafill fills the rest of the line with lines as used in the lla font.

macros.name: llaline
macros.doc: The command \llaline takes its argument and adds lines as used in the lla font underneath.

macros.name: textlla
macros.doc: This macro typesets its argument in the lla font.
